local_articles.title: Aston Villa sign Chelsea striker Nicolas Jackson for reported club record
local_articles.snippet: Aston Villa have signed Senegal striker Nicolas Jackson from Chelsea in a deal worth a reported club-record 65 million pounds ($88m). Jackson agreed a five-year deal with the Europa League holders on Friday and is reunited with Villa manager Unai Emery after the pair worked together at Villarreal. Emery had revealed the 25-year-old was set to sign when he spoke to the media in a news conference on Friday to preview Monday’s game against Arsenal. Jackson, who spent last season on loan at Bayern Munich, arrives at Villa Park as a replacement for Ollie Watkins, whose 50-million-pound ($68m) move to Saudi Arabian side Al Hilal is being finalised. Jackson had been training separately from Chelsea’s squad, having been told he was not in the plans of Blues boss Xabi Alonso. questions.title: Which club will win the Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United in September 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official match records, corroborated by contemporaneous match reports, for the September 2026 Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United. Resolution : Resolve to the club with more goals in the official final score after the match, including stoppage time. If the scores are level, resolve to “Draw”. Accepted Answer Format : The winning club's name, or “Draw” if neither club wins.
questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-08-22 to 2026-08-27 rebalance flips Manchester City back into slight away favorites for the Sep 13 Old Trafford derby. Confirmed market.csv resolutions and reporting show City rapidly rebuilding Enzo Maresca's midfield and wing depth with blockbuster signings of Chelsea vice-captain Enzo Fernandez (~£120m, confirmed Aug 27—already knows Maresca's system and brings immediate leadership), Lille teenager Ayyoub Bouaddi (€100m, Aug 23/26), and Palmeiras winger Allan Elias (£34m, Aug 24) alongside Elliot Anderson (£116m), while grinding out a 2-1 PL opening win vs Bournemouth via late Marc Guehi and Josko Gvardiol goals (even after also letting Omar Marmoush join Spurs and Nico Gonzalez join Newcastle). Conversely, Michael Carrick's Manchester United suffered a chastening 2-0 defeat at promoted Hull City in their Aug 22 opener, exposing set-piece vulnerability and sluggish attacking output despite signing Carlos Baleba (£70m) on Aug 25. Combining City's superior upgraded talent with transition/cohesion risk and Old Trafford home advantage (~1.54 vs ~1.38 xG in Dixon-Coles) yields 40% Manchester City, 34% Manchester United, and 26% Draw.

questions.title: Which stadium will UEFA select to host the 2029 men's Champions League final?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : UEFA's official announcement awarding hosting rights for the 2029 men's Champions League final, or reliable contemporaneous reporting of that announcement. Resolution Date : Resolve when UEFA publicly announces its venue selection. Subsequent venue changes will not alter the answer. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the selected stadium.
questions.current_reasoning: UEFA's June 10, 2026 final dossier deadline closed with a strict two-horse race between Barcelona's Camp Nou and London's Wembley Stadium, to be decided by the UEFA Executive Committee in Thessaloniki on September 14-15, 2026. Camp Nou holds a slight edge: its 104,600-seat renovation with ~9,000 VIP seats offers record UEFA revenue, marks 30 years since its 1999 final, serves as a 2030 World Cup rehearsal amid thawed Barça-UEFA ties, and Wembley already hosted the 2024 UCL final plus the July 2028 Euro final just 11 months earlier. Wembley remains a formidable 44% contender because Madrid's Metropolitano hosts the 2027 UCL final and Camp Nou carries residual renovation risk.

questions.title: Which country will Washington propose as a possible venue for renewed trilateral Russia–Ukraine ceasefire talks by September 25, 2026?
questions.background: The United States has been involved in efforts to broker an end to the Russia–Ukraine war.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the country publicly identified by Ukraine's president as Washington's proposed location for renewed talks involving the United States, Russia and Ukraine, using the proposal current as of September 25, 2026. A suggested location is sufficient; the talks need not have taken place. Resolution Date : 2026-09-25 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the country's common English name.
questions.current_reasoning: U.S.-brokered trilateral Russia–Ukraine talks paused after the February 16, 2026 Geneva round when the U.S.–Iran conflict began; in March, Washington proposed holding talks in the United States (Miami/Washington) while Russia refused and proposed Turkey or Switzerland, and an earlier Abu Dhabi round was shelved. As of June 24, talks remain frozen though U.S.-Iran diplomacy shows early signs of easing. If Washington proposes a venue for renewed trilateral talks by September 25, Turkey (24%) and Switzerland (22%) are the strongest compromise venues acceptable to both Kyiv and Moscow, while the United States (18%, Washington's standing proposal), the United Arab Emirates (14%, previously scheduled host), and Saudi Arabia (9%, 2025 talks host) remain key alternatives.

questions.current_reasoning: Major upgrade for 18-year-old Chinese prodigy Yan Ziyi (0.34 -> 0.57) and plain ASCII fix for Adriana Vilagos. Since June 24, Yan extended her undefeated Diamond League streak to four wins—67.44m in Paris on June 28 (beating Vilagos 63.83m and Kitaguchi 63.01m, while world champ Juleisy Angulo finished last; SCMP) and 68.75m in Monaco on July 10 (Reuters), giving her four marks from 67.11m to 71.74m. Meanwhile, European rivals underwhelmed at the Aug 16 European Championships in Birmingham, where Sara Kolak won gold with just 62.43m (Straits Times), underscoring Yan's massive 5m+ superiority. We cap Yan at 0.57 pending formal Budapest entry confirmation (given late-September Asian Games proximity) and inherent javelin event variance, leaving 10% outside the top 5 (Sigrid Borge, Sara Kolak, Victoria Hudson, Juleisy Angulo).

questions.background: The Campeones Cup is an annual match between the previous season’s MLS Cup champion and the winner of Mexico’s Campeón de Campeones.

Resolution : Resolve to the club officially declared the winner of the 2026 Campeones Cup once the match has concluded, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required. questions.current_reasoning: Matchup is now 100% locked following the July 25 Campeon de Campeones: Cruz Azul defeated Toluca FC 3-1 (double by Jose Paradela, goal by Charly Rodriguez) to earn the Liga MX berth, eliminating Toluca FC (0.28 -> 0.00). Official Inter Miami CF confirmation places Inter Miami CF vs. Cruz Azul at Miami's Nu Stadium on Sept 16. Liga MX leads the all-time Campeones Cup 4-3 despite MLS home advantage, and Cruz Azul (reigning 2025 CONCACAF Champions Cup and Clausura 2026 champions) looked dominant against Toluca, whereas Inter Miami—still 2nd overall in MLS with Lionel Messi back scoring/assisting on Aug 19 and Rodrigo De Paul/German Berterame returning—are in a modest slump (1 win in 6 across all competitions, eliminated 1-2-0 in Leagues Cup). We give Cruz Azul a slight edge (0.53) over home side Inter Miami CF (0.47).
